what: Several photos fanned out and overlapping in the same cell (each offset x 10% · y −5% · 5°, the whole bundle −2°) spread out on hover as the spacing doubles and rotation moves to −4° with the bundle at +1° — a .9s bouncy curve (overshoots to 1.03 and settles back). The shape signals a ‹bundle› rather than a ‹single item›

options.--fx-gap-x·--fx-gap-y: Distance each sheet moves aside (CSS variable), default 10cqi · −5cqi (proportional to element width)
options.--fx-rotate·--fx-offset-rotate: Per-card rotation and whole-stack rotation, default 5deg·−2deg
options.--fx-open-gap-x·--fx-open-gap-y·--fx-ope: Values after unfolding, default double the gap · −4deg · 1deg
options.--fx-width·--fx-ratio·--fx-offset-y: Width of each photo (relative to element) · ratio · group vertical offset, defaults 40% · 130/162 · 0

note: The original expands when a hand is over the whole card (including the title link) — so here the whole element with data-fx is the hover area. It also expands when keyboard focus lands on an inner link.
